'Recommended actions (from action codes)

• X-S1.1 — Service Level Orchestration
  Owner: head_of_service_operations
  Trigger: svc.sla.attainment.pct < 92.0%
  Impact: High
  Expected: 3.0–8.0 pp
  Confidence: High
  · DETECT sustained SLA deterioration for this case
  · DIAGNOSE the dominant service constraint for this case
  · ACTIVATE the corresponding execution Action Code for this case
  ⚠ Trigger only if backlog growth or escalations confirm structural issue
  ⚠ Do not trigger if SLA miss is caused by one-off incidents

• X-S1.2 — Capacity & Backlog Stabilisation
  Owner: service_operations_manager
  Trigger: svc.backlog.count > 0.25%
  Impact: High
  Expected: -15.0–-35.0 %
  Confidence: High
  · IDENTIFY cases in queues with sustained backlog growth
  · REALLOCATE capacity or extend operating windows for this case backlog
  · EXECUTE backlog reduction waves targeting this case type
  ⚠ Trigger only if backlog growth exceeds arrival rate trend
  ⚠ Do not trigger if backlog increase is quality-driven

• X-S1.3 — Quality & First-Contact Resolution Uplift
  Owner: quality_and_training_lead
  Trigger: svc.fcr.pct < 65.0%
  Impact: High
  Expected: 5.0–12.0 pp
  Confidence: Medium
  · IDENTIFY cases with low first-contact resolution by queue/agent group
  · DIAGNOSE top repeat-contact drivers for this case type
  · DEPLOY targeted coaching, scripts, or knowledge updates for this case type
  ⚠ Trigger only if repeat contacts drive backlog growth
  ⚠ Do not trigger if low FCR is caused by missing authority to resolve

• X-S1.4 — Handling Time & Flow Efficiency
  Owner: service_operations_manager
  Trigger: svc.aht.minutes > 0.25%
  Impact: Medium
  Expected: -5.0–-15.0 %
  Confidence: Medium
  · IDENTIFY cases with rising average handling time by queue
  · ANALYSE top handling-time drivers for this case type
  · REMOVE or STREAMLINE non-value steps in this case handling process
  ⚠ Trigger only if AHT increase is not quality-driven
  ⚠ Do not trigger if AHT rise is caused by training or onboarding'
